profileName: Enterprise Commercial Landscape and Market Scope

cases.input: Perimeter A contains S1; perimeter B consolidates S1 and S2.
cases.expect: The same facts yield distinct valid outputs under pinned perimeter definitions.

cases.input: Order S1 to S2 is external to A and intercompany inside B.
cases.expect: The fact is retained in A and eliminated in B under their declared rules.

cases.input: Party P buys from S1 and supplies S2.
cases.expect: Customer concentration and supplier dependency remain separate observations over one party anchor.

cases.input: One ultimate parent is disputed and another is unknown.
cases.expect: The disputed fact produces attributed ranges and the unknown stays a reason-coded singleton.

cases.input: Regional subtotals and their underlying order lines are summed together.
cases.expect: The rollup is rejected because each fact key may contribute once.

cases.input: CRM account hierarchy is treated as proof of ownership and consolidation.
cases.expect: The inferred group edges are rejected.

cases.input: An open opportunity forecast is reported as recognized revenue.
cases.expect: The substitution is rejected because forecast and authoritative facts are separate measures.

cases.input: A control boundary is used to eliminate an order between two controlled parties without a consolidation rule.
cases.expect: The elimination is rejected; ownership or control alone is insufficient.

cases.input: One concentration numerator mixes order lines and observed revenue while labelling both as one fact key.
cases.expect: The projection is rejected because a run uses exactly one fact key.

cases.input: The disclosure shape changes while facts and perimeter remain fixed.
cases.expect: A new Market Scope edition and projection digest are produced; the prior projection remains immutable.

cases.input: A projection includes another controller fact without an explicit grant and governed shape.
cases.expect: The fact is excluded or the result is typed unevaluable without exposing its presence.

cases.input: Two periods with different grouping boundaries are compared without a governed remapping.
cases.expect: The comparison is rejected as non-comparable.

cases.input: One pinned boundary revision contains claimant-attributed G1 and G2 hypotheses for Z.
cases.expect: Range endpoints are derived within that one revision and retain claimant attribution.

cases.input: An authorization denial is emitted as forecast coverage unevaluable.
cases.expect: The output is rejected; denial is externally omission while coverage unevaluable remains an evidentiary state.

cases.input: The projection digest binds a different fact key than the authoritative Market Scope edition.
cases.expect: Generation fails hard; digest pins cannot override or resolve Scope divergence.

cases.input: Market Scope defines customer segments inline without an external governed revision.
cases.expect: The edition is rejected as a shadow classification master.

cases.input: P1 and P2 projections with different elimination rules are set-unioned without governed remapping.
cases.expect: The group union is forbidden because the same fact could be reintroduced or silently suppressed.
